meta.ruleset: AD&D 2nd Edition (Player's Handbook / Dungeon Master's Guide). NOT 5th edition.
meta.provenance: xpTables, classGroups, saveCategories and abilityScores.fields were extracted from the Tradestands character record sheets (v6.0; Monk v6.3). Sections with status 'needs-source' are empty skeletons: enter them from your PHB/DMG and run the validator. spellProgression comes from PHB Tables 21 and 24 (images supplied by owner). specialistWizards comes from PHB Table 22 (image supplied by owner). Paladin spell progression comes from PHB Table 17 (image supplied by owner). Ranger spell progression comes from PHB Table 18 (image supplied by owner). Bard spell progression comes from PHB Table 32 (image supplied by owner). Race height, weight, age and aging come from PHB Tables 10-12 (images supplied by owner). Strength table comes from PHB Table 1 (image supplied by owner). Dexterity table comes from PHB Table 2 (image supplied by owner). Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma tables come from PHB Tables 4-6 (images supplied by owner). Constitution table comes from PHB Table 3 (image supplied by owner). Alignments and class requirements were supplied by the owner. Ranger ability minimums, prime requisites, alignment and XP bonus come from PHB text supplied by the owner. Paladin requirements come from PHB text supplied by the owner. Class ability minimums come from PHB Table 13 (image supplied by owner). Warrior hit dice, melee attacks (Table 15) and Fighter requirements come from PHB text and a table supplied by the owner. Mage requirements come from PHB text supplied by the owner. Illusionist requirements come from PHB text supplied by the owner. Cleric requirements come from PHB text supplied by the owner. Druid requirements come from PHB text supplied by the owner. Thief requirements come from PHB text supplied by the owner. Bard requirements come from PHB text supplied by the owner. THAC0 comes from PHB Table 53 (image supplied by owner). Saving throws come from PHB Table 60 (image supplied by owner). Base movement by race was supplied by the owner. Encumbrance and modified movement come from PHB Tables 47 and 48 (images supplied by owner). Multi-class combinations by race were supplied by the owner.

con.source: PHB Table 3: Constitution (image supplied by owner)

columns.hpAdjPerDie: Hit Point Adjustment: bonus or penalty per Hit Die (sheet: HP Adjustment). Non-warriors are capped at +2 per die.
columns.hpAdjPerDieWarrior: The parenthetical figure, applying to warriors only. Equal to hpAdjPerDie where the table prints no parenthesis.
columns.minHitDieResult: Lowest value a rolled Hit Die counts as (see footnotes). null = no minimum.
columns.regeneration: Regeneration, stored as 1 hit point every N turns (not on the sheets)

footnotes.*: The parenthetical bonus applies to warriors only. All other classes receive a maximum bonus of +2 per die.
footnotes.**: All 1s rolled for Hit Dice are automatically considered 2s.
footnotes.***: All 1s and 2s rolled for Hit Dice are automatically considered 3s.
footnotes.****: All 1s, 2s and 3s rolled for Hit Dice are automatically considered 4s.

con.regenerationNote: Printed as '1/6 turns' ... '1/1 turn'. Read as one hit point regained every N turns. Confirm.
con.warriorClasses: fighter, paladin, ranger (class group warrior in classGroups). Confirm that the Monk (house class) is not treated as a warrior for this.
con.houseRuleNote: House rule: the CON hit point adjustment continues at every level for every class (house.json hitPointRules.conBonusAllLevels). The core rule stops it at name level.

multiClass.source: Owner list of multi-class combinations by race (text)
rules: Multi-class combinations are limited to the lists below for each race.
A character must meet the minimum ability scores of EVERY class in the combination (owner).
No level limits apply to any multi-class combination (owner; see house.json levelLimits).
The Bard appears in no multi-class combination, ever (owner). A thief/bard combination does not exist.
Armour and spellcasting limits for multi-class characters (e.g. a mage in armour) are handled outside the app; the app does not enforce them (owner).
Thief skill points in any multi-class combination that includes a thief are awarded per thief level only (confirmed by owner).

multiClass.humans: No multi-class combinations listed for humans. Dual-classing is ignored (owner).
multiClass.combinedMinimumsRule: For each ability, the highest minimum among the classes in the combination (computed in 'combinations').
multiClass.alignmentRule: Allowed alignments are the overlap of the classes' allowed alignments (computed), except where an override exists (Druid/Ranger = Neutral Good).

weaponRestrictions.rule: Alkyls, atlatl, hand axe, club, hand crossbow, dagger, javelin, polearms, spear, staff, throwing stars, wakizashi swords, scimitars and whips. (In the Forgotten Realms certain gods may allow other weapons.)

encumbrance.source: PHB Table 47: Character Encumbrance (image supplied by owner)
encumbrance.strengthRows: Keys match abilityScores.table.str rows. The table starts at STR 2 (no STR 1 row).
encumbrance.crossCheck: The Unencumbered upper limit equals the Weight Allowance on the Strength table (Table 1) for every row, and the Severe upper limit equals the Max Carried Weight.
encumbrance.howToUse: Total the weight carried and find which band it falls in for the character's Strength. Max carried weight is the most he can carry.
encumbrance.effectsOfCategories: Table 47 gives the weight bands only. The movement effect of each band comes from Table 48 (modified movement rate).

modifiedMovement.source: PHB Table 48: Modified Movement Rates (image supplied by owner)
modifiedMovement.meaning: Each column is a movement rate. The numbers in a Strength row are the heaviest weight (in pounds) the character can carry and still move at that column's rate. The top figure of each column is the rate for base move 12, the lower figure the rate for base move 6.
modifiedMovement.howToUse: Find the character's Strength row, then the first column (from the left) whose weight limit is at least the weight he is carrying. The rate is the column's baseMove12Rate or baseMove6Rate, depending on his base move.
modifiedMovement.howToUseStatus: interpretation: confirm against the PHB wording
modifiedMovement.baseMovesNote: Table 48 only covers base moves 12 and 6, which are the only base moves in the race data (Monk movement is separate, in house.json).
modifiedMovement.dashes: A dash is stored as null: that rate is not reached at that Strength (the two lowest rows are sparse).

armourClass.status: confirmed-by-owner definitions, for the PDF export and sheet
armourClass.signConvention: Lower AC is better. dexDefenseAdj is the 'defenseAdj' value from abilityScores dex table (negative improves AC, positive worsens it). shieldBenefit = the AC improvement the character's shield gives = 1 for the shield + its magical plus, as a positive number.
armourClass.calculatedAc: The character's full AC as shown on the sheet: armour, shield, magical pluses, Dexterity defense adjustment and other modifiers.

natural.label: Natural AC
natural.text: Always based on an unarmoured PC: 10, adjusted only by the Dexterity defense adjustment (no armour, shield or magic).

surprised.label: Surprised AC
surprised.text: The character's calculated AC minus the Dexterity defense adjustment.

shieldless.label: Shieldless AC
shieldless.text: The character's calculated AC minus their shield and any magical pluses it confers.

rear.label: Rear AC
rear.text: The character's calculated AC minus their shield and any magical pluses it confers, minus the Dexterity defense adjustment.

example.source: owner-supplied worked example; matches the formulas

notes: 'Minus the shield' means the shield's AC benefit is removed, so AC number goes UP (worse) by shieldBenefit.
Shield base improvement is 1 for the shield (owner confirmed); shield-type-specific benefits are not applied.
Rear = armour only (calculated AC with shield and DEX both removed). Surprised = armour and shield, no DEX. Shieldless = armour and DEX, no shield.

shieldBenefit.example: A +2 shield gives a total modifier of -3 to AC: -1 for the shield and -2 for the magic bonus, so shieldBenefit = 3.
